data.vehicle_damage_summary: The vehicle has sustained severe front-end collision damage, resulting in the complete loss and displacement of the front bumper cover. The front bumper reinforcement bar is fully exposed and exhibits direct impact damage. Additionally, the lower turbocharger intercooler charge pipe is severely displaced, hanging loose from the engine bay, and marked with repairer notation. Due to the high-severity nature of the front-end impact, the underlying energy absorber and bumper mounting brackets are also designated for replacement.
